items.headline: Klay Thompson Joins Miami Heat After Mavericks Buyout
items.summary: Five-time All-Star Klay Thompson is headed to South Beach, agreeing to join the Miami Heat on August 21, 2026, following a contract buyout with the Dallas Mavericks. Thompson is expected to sign a two-year deal worth nearly $13 million, featuring a player option in the second year. This move reportedly creates a 'super trio' alongside Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo.

items.headline: DeMar DeRozan Agrees to One-Year Deal with Denver Nuggets
items.summary: Veteran six-time All-Star DeMar DeRozan has reached an agreement to sign a one-year, $3.9 million contract with the Denver Nuggets. DeRozan became available after being waived by the Sacramento Kings earlier this offseason. The 37-year-old averaged 18.4 points, 4.1 assists, and 2.9 rebounds in 77 games with the Kings last season.

items.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo Lands in Miami in Blockbuster Trade
items.summary: In one of the most significant moves of the offseason, Giannis Antetokounmpo was traded to the Miami Heat from the Milwaukee Bucks, a deal reported in late June and July. The Heat acquired Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis. Milwaukee received Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kasparas Jakucionis, three first-round picks, a pick swap, and a second-round pick in return.

items.headline: Peyton Watson Headlines Five-Team Trade to Cleveland
items.summary: A complex five-team trade, finalized around August 20-21, sent restricted free agent Peyton Watson from the Denver Nuggets to the Cleveland Cavaliers. The Cavaliers also acquired Cam Whitmore from the Wizards. The Nuggets received Julian Reese from Washington, an unprotected 2031 first-round pick from Cleveland, and a 2032 second-round pick from Sacramento.

items.headline: Klay Thompson's Heat Contract Details Emerge
items.summary: Klay Thompson's anticipated move to the Miami Heat will see him sign a two-year contract for nearly $13 million, including a player option for the second season. This represents a significant reduction from the $17.5 million he was owed by the Mavericks, signaling Thompson's desire to join a contender.

items.headline: DeMar DeRozan Takes Veteran Minimum with Nuggets
items.summary: DeMar DeRozan's agreement with the Denver Nuggets is for one year and the veteran minimum of $3.9 million. This signing provides the Nuggets with an experienced backcourt presence as they look to build on their roster.

items.headline: Offseason Coaching Carousel Continues Across the League
items.summary: The 2026 NBA offseason has seen numerous coaching changes. Notable hires include Taylor Jenkins (Milwaukee Bucks), Tiago Splitter (Chicago Bulls), Jamahl Mosley (New Orleans Pelicans), Sean Sweeney (Orlando Magic), Dusty May (Dallas Mavericks), and Micah Nori (Portland Trail Blazers). Additionally, Phil Handy is reportedly joining the Philadelphia 76ers as an assistant coach.

items.headline: LeBron James' 76ers Debut and Christmas Day Return Set
items.summary: The recently released 2026-27 NBA schedule highlights LeBron James' debut with the Philadelphia 76ers on October 20 against the defending champion New York Knicks. Fans can also mark their calendars for his Christmas Day return to Los Angeles, where the 76ers will face Luka Doncic and the Lakers.
